# BMI Calculator
> Free online BMI calculator for men, women and children. Enter height and weight in kg/cm or lb/ft to get BMI, healthy weight range, BMI Prime, Ponderal Index and the WHO adult or CDC child category. Available in 8 languages.

Reviewed 21 November 2026. Medical information is general, not advice.

## Key facts
- Formula (metric): BMI = weight (kg) / height (m)^2. US units: 703 x pounds / inches^2.
- WHO adult classes: under 16 severe thinness, 16-17 moderate, 17-18.5 mild, 18.5-25 normal, 25-30 overweight, 30-35 obese I, 35-40 obese II, over 40 obese III.
- Healthy weight range for a height: 18.5 to 25 times height in metres squared.
- Ages 2-20: CDC BMI-for-age percentiles (under 5% underweight, 5-85% healthy, 85-95% at risk of overweight, over 95% overweight).
- Many Asian guidelines use overweight from 23 and obese from 25.
